from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyContractLiability(BaseModel):
    """Contract liability value reported for one company in one financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the report")
    contract_liability: float | None = Field(description="The contract liability amount reported; None if not disclosed")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. 'CNY' or '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt showing the contract liability value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    contract_liabilities: list[CompanyContractLiability]
